transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

My work physical is what started all this. The doctor there said my weight was too low and wanted me to come in. I don’t really feel sick or anything—I just feel lighter, like I move better playing basketball, and I’m not as weighed down when I’m working at the garage.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or the amount of food you eat lately?

Yeah, I guess I eat less than I used to. Most days it’s just coffee in the morning, then maybe a small sandwich later, or half of whatever’s around. With the shop running late and things busy at home, it’s just easier for me to stick to my own simple routine.
Have you lost weight on purpose, or has the weight loss happened without you trying?

I mean, I guess it’s partly on purpose. Most days I keep it pretty light—coffee in the morning, then maybe a small sandwich later, or half of whatever’s around. With the shop running late and the house being busy, I just feel better sticking to my own simple rules.
Has your reduced eating been something you’ve chosen to do, or has it been harder to eat because food doesn’t taste good, you feel full quickly, or you’ve lost interest in eating?

It’s more something I’m choosing, I guess. Food doesn’t taste bad or anything—I just keep it light. Most days it’s coffee in the morning, then maybe a small sandwich later, or half of whatever’s around. With the shop running late and things busy at home, I feel better sticking to my own simple rules.
Have you been intentionally limiting the amount of food you eat or avoiding certain types of food to keep your weight down?

Yeah, I have been limiting it. Most days I just keep it to coffee in the morning, then maybe a small sandwich later or half of whatever’s around. With the shop running late and things busy at home, it just feels better if I stick to my own simple rules.
Have you ever made yourself sick or used medications like laxatives or diuretics to control your weight?
No, not really. I haven’t made myself sick or used stuff like that. It’s more just me keeping the food amount low.
Have you noticed any physical symptoms like fatigue, weakness, or changes in your skin, hair, or nails recently?

I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed anything big like that. Maybe I get worn out sometimes, but I figure that’s just work and everything going on. I haven’t paid much attention to my skin or hair or nails.
Do you worry about gaining weight or becoming fat, even though others might see you as being at a normal or even low weight?

Yeah… I do worry about it. If the scale goes up even a pound, or my jeans feel a little tighter, I start thinking I’m getting soft. Then I worry I’ll be slower moving around cars at work or up and down the court.
Do you see yourself as overweight or needing to lose weight even when you look in the mirror or when others comment that you seem thin?

I mean… I know people say I look thin and they’re worried, but I don’t really see it that way. I figure they’re making too much out of it. I’m still getting to work, handling stuff at home, and playing ball on the weekends, so it doesn’t feel like it’s that serious.
